Its laws are mu_C=(e,2q-e,1-2q) and r_C=(c^2+e^2,e(2q-e)(s^2+q^2)/q^2,2e(1-2q)), and D(mu_i||r_i)=D(mu_C||r_C). Therefore M_i/e=e log2((c^2+e^2)/e^2)+(2q-e)log2((s^2+q^2)/q^2)+1-2q. For each coordinate i define epsilon_i=Inf_i, mu_i(T)=fhat(T+i)^2/epsilon_i, r_i(T)=fhat(T)^2+fhat(T+i)^2, and let bar_mu_i,bar_r_i be their pushforwards under T->|T|. Every epsilon_i=epsilon=2p beta^(m-1), I=2w beta^(m-1), and 0<=D2(bar_mu_i||bar_r_i)<=3+log2(w+1/2). Defining M=sum_i epsilon_i[log2(1/epsilon_i)-D2(mu_i||r_i)] and M_degree=sum_i epsilon_i[log2(1/epsilon_i)-D2(bar_mu_i||bar_r_i)], one has M_degree/I>=w-4-log2(w+1/2), hence M_degree/I>=w/2 for w>=32, while 0<=M<=B<=H<=6I for all w>=4. The exact discarded conditional refund is M_degree-M=sum_i epsilon_i sum_t bar_mu_i(t) D2(mu_i(.|t)||r_i(.|t)), and divided by I it is at least w/2-6 for w>=32.
